item.title: Neighbourhood wardens to patrol Balham in £170k trial to tackle crime and anti-social behaviour
item.description: Neighbourhood wardens are set to patrol a South London neighbourhood for the first time in a new trial scheme. Wandsworth Council plans to roll out the £170,000 pilot in Balham for six months to tackle crime and anti-social behaviour, with the potential to introduce it in other parts of the borough if it is successful.
